title: Sparkly flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7a8' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff7a8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles around pot -->
  <g fill='#ffe86b'>
    <circle cx='14' cy='30' r='3'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='34' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='72' r='2.4'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='76' r='3'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='10' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='14' r='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <g fill='#fff3b0'>
    <path d='M10 52 l2 -6 2 6 6 2 -6 2 -2 6 -2 -6 -6 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M88 52 l2 -6 2 6 6 2 -6 2 -2 6 -2 -6 -6 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M30 18 l1.6 -5 1.6 5 5 1.6 -5 1.6 -1.6 5 -1.6 -5 -5 -1.6 z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='28' y='56' width='44' height='11' rx='3' fill='#e8734a'/>
  <rect x='28' y='56' width='44' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff9a6b'/>
  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M32 66 h36 l-5 24 a3 3 0 0 1 -3 2 h-20 a3 3 0 0 1 -3 -2 z' fill='#cf5a35'/>
  <path d='M40 68 h8 l-3 22 h-2 z' fill='#ff9a6b' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='19' ry='4' fill='#6b4a3a'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='34' width='3' height='24' fill='#4fbf5c'/>
  <!-- leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='46' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#5fd66c' transform='rotate(-25 40 46)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='42' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#3fa94d' transform='rotate(25 60 42)'/>
  <!-- flower petals -->
  <g fill='#ff7bc2'>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='5' ry='8'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='5' ry='8'/>
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='30' rx='8' ry='5'/>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='30' rx='8' ry='5'/>
    <ellipse cx='43' cy='23' rx='7' ry='5' transform='rotate(-45 43 23)'/>
    <ellipse cx='57' cy='23' rx='7' ry='5' transform='rotate(45 57 23)'/>
    <ellipse cx='43' cy='37' rx='7' ry='5' transform='rotate(45 43 37)'/>
    <ellipse cx='57' cy='37' rx='7' ry='5' transform='rotate(-45 57 37)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- flower center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='6.5' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='3' fill='#ffb32b'/>
  <!-- soft glows -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='16' fill='url(#glow)'/>
</svg>
